projectDescription: Automated deployment of Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Fleet Server using Podman with hardened Wolfi images, supporting single-node, multi-node, and WSL2 environments via shell scripts and Ansible playbooks.
keyFeatures: One-command deployment of Elasticsearch 9.4.4 with hardened Wolfi images via Podman
Automated Kibana setup with enrollment token generation and SSL certificate management
Fleet Server deployment for Elastic Agent management
Rootless Podman 5+ support with systemd Quadlet orchestration
Ansible playbook automation with idempotent, declarative state management
Cosign image signature verification for supply chain security
Configurable bind addresses for local or networked deployments
Ansible-driven WSL2 kernel tuning (vm.max_map_count, inotify, file descriptors)
publicApiSurface: setup_elasticsearch.sh — pulls Wolfi Elasticsearch image, configures Podman network, starts container, generates credentials
setup_kibana.sh — pulls Wolfi Kibana image, extracts default config, starts container with custom kibana.yml
setup_fleet_server.sh — pulls Wolfi elastic-agent-complete image, configures Fleet Server with service token
run_playbooks.sh — master Ansible runner invoking ansible/main.yml with inventory support
ansible/group_vars/all.yml — global variables: elk_version, deployment_option, bind addresses, image names, ports
podman-compose-kibana.yml — Kibana container definition with volume and custom config mount
